identifier.value: Clube do Técnico acquired by Tractian

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Tractian is focused on developing systems and methods for automatic detection of mechanical failures in rotating machines. Their research involves a sensing device that is coupled to mechanical machines to detect vibrations. This data is then transmitted to a remote processing device for analysis, which aids in condition monitoring and asset performance management for industrial operations. This highlights Tractian's commitment to enhancing machine intelligence through advanced monitoring technologies.

product.name: Smart Trac Sensor
product.description: An IoT sensor that monitors vibration, temperature, and operational parameters of industrial equipment in real time to detect potential failures early and reduce downtime.

product.name: Smart Trac Ultra Sensor
product.description: An advanced IoT sensor that monitors vibration, temperature, and RPM with AI-driven auto-diagnosis to detect and diagnose machine faults in real time, including in hazardous areas.

product.name: TracOS™ CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System)
product.description: A cloud-based maintenance management software that centralizes asset control, maintenance planning, inventory management, and work order tracking to optimize industrial maintenance operations.

product.name: Energy Trac Sensor
product.description: An IoT sensor that monitors electrical parameters like current, voltage, power, and energy consumption in real time to support energy management and efficiency in industrial facilities.
